<!-- _includes/datatype.qmd
     Pilot: inline text-native micro-charts via the `datatype` OpenType font
     (SIL OFL 1.1; vendored at assets/datatype.woff2, license text at
     assets/datatype-OFL.txt — see https://github.com/franktisellano/datatype).
     The font renders `{b:v,...}` (bars), `{l:v,...}` (sparkline), and
     `{p:v}` (pie) glyphs via OpenType ligatures for values 0-100 (<=20
     points). Scoped to `.dt` spans ONLY — never applied to body text, since
     the ligatures would otherwise corrupt ordinary `{}` braces appearing in
     prose or code chunks.
     Usage: {{< include /_includes/datatype.qmd >}}
     Helper: dt_spec(x, type = c("l", "b", "p")) returns a ready-to-splice
     <span class="dt" title="...">{type:v,...}</span> string; the title
     attribute is a plain-text fallback for alt-text / font-load failure.
     See JohnGavin/llm#841.
-->

```{=html}
<style>
@font-face {
  font-family: "Datatype";
  src: url("/assets/datatype.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-display: swap;
}
.dt {
  font-family: "Datatype", monospace;
  font-feature-settings: "liga" 1, "calt" 1;
  font-size: 1.15em;
  line-height: 1;
}
</style>
```

```{r datatype-helper, include=FALSE}
dt_spec <- function(x, type = c("l", "b", "p")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  if (type == "p") {
    v <- round(x[1])
  } else {
    rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    v <- if (diff(rng) == 0) rep(50, length(x))
         else round(100 * (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng))
    v <- utils::head(v, 20)
  }
  spec <- sprintf("{%s:%s}", type, paste(v, collapse = ","))
  sprintf('<span class="dt" title="%s">%s</span>',
          paste(round(x, 1), collapse = " "), spec)
}
```
